title: marla's page !!!

profile.bio:
[b]MARLA. 19. MARCHFIELD, VERITY CO.[/b]

[i]if you are here from school no you arent[/i]

[img:banner:marla-header]

things i like: my car (1994 escort, teal, one hubcap), coffee, the blue kestrel, bad horror movies, my job at the video place (2 more weeks lol), driving on 62 at night with the windows down even in january

things i do NOT like: PEOPLE WHO PARK IN TWO SPACES. people who say "marchfield isnt even a real town" (you live in gridfall which is 4 miles away. sit down). the smell inside the video place. my manager. the timetable.

[b]I DO NOT ADD PEOPLE I HAVE NOT MET.[/b] unless ur cool.

if u want the layout code i got it off [url=synth://webring.gridfall.net/]the webring[/url], im not writing it out again

[b]~*~*~ thanks for reading ~*~*~[/b]
profile.mood: tired but like, in a fun way

feed.author: MARLA
feed.body:
cant sleep so heres a thing.

went out to 62 tonight with kelsey and bran because bran has been going ON about this radio signal thing for a month. theres a whole forum about it, theres a guy who TAPES it.

we sat at the pull off by the quarry turn for an hour and a half. bran had a radio from his dads garage that weighed like nine pounds.

we heard: static. static. a country station out of somewhere. more static. kelsey's stomach. nothing.

bran says you have to go at like 10:47 exactly which. ok bran.

it was still a good night though. thats the stupid part. we didnt hear anything and it was still one of the better nights ive had in a while.

feed.author: MARLA
feed.body:
doris (the car) made a noise today. a NEW noise.

its not the belt noise. the belt noise is a squeal and i know the belt noise, we are old friends me and the belt noise. this is a knock and it happens when i turn left and only when i turn left and only above about 30.

my dad got under it for twenty minutes and came out and said "hm".

that is all he said. HM. so thats where we are.

feed.author: MARLA
feed.body:
took the 17:52 up to verity central on saturday just to do it. i have lived here my entire life and i have been on that train maybe four times.

there were nine people on it. NINE. in four carriages.

my dad says when he was my age you couldnt get a seat on a friday. theres a forum full of men who talk about this train like its a person who is dying and honestly after saturday i kind of get it.

feed.author: MARLA
feed.body:
three months at the printers.

things i can now do that i could not do in february:
- load the big machine without help
- tell you what 80lb gloss feels like with my eyes shut
- talk to walt for a full shift without wanting to lie down

walt has worked there 31 years. he brings a thermos. he has strong opinions about the substation fire in 03 and he will tell you them. he was RIGHT there, he says. he says it every day. i have heard about the substation fire more times than i have heard my own name.

i like walt.

replies.author: MARGUERITE H.
replies.body: If Walt was on Elm Street that afternoon somebody should write down what he saw before he retires. Two bangs or one, ask him. There's a whole page about it and it's mostly guessing: [url=synth://wiki.gridfall.net/wiki/gridfall-substation-fire]wiki.gridfall.net[/url]

replies.author: MARLA
replies.body: i will ask him monday. he is going to be SO happy someone asked

feed.author: MARLA
feed.body:
[b]ok. real one.[/b]

kelsey is moving in november. not far, an hour forty, but its an hour forty.

everyone keeps saying "thats nothing, thats a drive" and yeah. it is a drive. i have doris and doris now has a new cv joint and she will do an hour forty.

but its not nothing. the whole thing about kelsey is she is ten minutes away. shes been ten minutes away since we were six. thats the entire thing.

i am happy for her. i AM. the job is good and its the one she wanted and if she stayed here for me i would be furious.

anyway. going to the kestrel with her sunday. probably wont write about it.

replies.body: im crying at my desk marla. its 11pm why am i at my desk

replies.body: an hour forty is nothing sweetheart. it is also everything. both of those are true and you'll find that out over about ten years.
